name: Emission-Absorption Mapping
definition: A mapping strategy for scalar data fields $f(\mathbf{x})$ to model parameters (emission $q$ and absorption $\kappa$) in emission-absorption models, where no scattering is taken into account.
summary: Emission-Absorption Mapping translates scalar data into emission and absorption parameters using user-defined functions that often incorporate geometric cues like gradients for shading and boundary emphasis.
